measurement_scope: Offline compact source seed generation/replay; not LeWM execution or speedup.

diagnostics.scope: SCAR analysis processes only; no target execution or values
diagnostics.fallback: Single-file startup cProfile, selected automatically by largest observed source bytes
diagnostics.generation_timing: Completed before diagnostic attempts and concurrent profile
diagnostics.replay_timing: May overlap the separate instrumented single-file source diagnostic; not a clean benchmark

source_profile.scope: Instrumented single source-code match; not target execution, clean benchmark or semantic proof
source_profile.selection: largest current source bytes among generated VERIFIED code links
